item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E003","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The report states that Committee against Torture inquiries concluded in 1996 and 2017 that torture in Egypt was widespread and systematic, and that 31 UN Human Rights Council states expressed concern in 2021 while the UN Human Rights Committee reiterated concern in April 2023 about counter-terrorism legislation.","notes":["The excerpt supports the two inquiries and the 2021 and 2023 concerns, but does not say that the 2021 or 2023 concerns specifically targeted human-rights defenders; that detail appears in the surrounding context only for the 2021 statement and is not repeated for April 2023."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E008","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E009","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E011","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"On 15 January 2023, the Emergency State Security Court convicted 82 of 103 defendants in the Joker case, including 23 children at the time of arrest; it sentenced 38 to life imprisonment and the others to 15-, 10-, or five-year terms, with five years of police surveillance after release.","notes":["The excerpt says 29 defendants were children at the time of arrest, but only 23 children were among those convicted. The summary correctly refers to 23 in the conviction sentence, but its opening wording could otherwise be read as describing all 103 defendants."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E012","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E013","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E014","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E015","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E016","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E017","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"By December 2023, Egypt faced a severe economic crisis: foreign investors withdrew $20 billion from Egyptian debt after Russia’s invasion of Ukraine; the pound had halved against the dollar since March 2022; annual inflation was almost 35 percent in November; and 60 percent of the population fit international definitions of poverty before the latest crisis.","notes":["The excerpt says investors pulled out $20 billion, not explicitly that this was the total amount withdrawn from Egyptian debt by all investors; the narrowed wording preserves the reported claim. The excerpt also links the crisis to extensive foreign borrowing for infrastructure and separately identifies the Ukraine-related investor withdrawal."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E018","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E019","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E020","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E021","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E022","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"After Sudan’s conflict began in April 2023, the Egyptian government introduced a visa requirement for all Sudanese nationals; around 500,000 Sudanese refugees were estimated to have fled to Egypt, and UNHCR estimated that 3,000 people were deported from Egypt to Sudan in September 2023 alone.","notes":["The excerpt supports the visa requirement, approximate refugee figure, and September 2023 deportation estimate, but does not state that the visa requirement was introduced because of the war; it says it was introduced in the following month."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E023","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E024","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E025","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E026","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E027","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E028","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
